usedFor: Ideanote collects ideas and Google Docs holds the write-up, so “New Ideas” can run “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Ideas” in Ideanote, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Each new idea is added to a doc tab, so reviewers read one page instead of many.

watchOut: “Add or Replace Text In Tab” can replace a tab's existing content, so choose add rather than replace.
